name: GraphQL Metatag
version_note: Targets the GraphQL 3.x plugin API: it depends on the graphql_core submodule and uses @GraphQLField/@GraphQLType annotations, neither of which exist in GraphQL 4.x/5.x. On a site running drupal/graphql >= 4 (this site has 5.0.0) the module cannot be enabled — its dependency graphql:graphql_core is unavailable. Documented from source.
